barinel.reason: None of the five frozen role reports had an independent executable pass/fail component spectrum with justified priors; numeric BARINEL probabilities would be fabricated.

findings.finding: The historical event-20161 inventory is internally self-consistent for its declared population, but it is not a live certification: all 38 caller names still resolve, 21/21 trigger bindings remain mapped, yet 22/38 caller definitions have changed by empirical md5(prosrc) comparison.

Current lexical topology shows selective evolution: 70/76 historical callee tokens remain in current bodies and six do not; changed bodies expose newer cached-v2/context/handoff paths. This is structural evidence, not runtime execution proof.

Coverage cannot be promoted from historical to live without qualification: 6/39 historical callee tokens have multiple current schema candidates, and 64 current IG-pattern functions are outside the historical caller set, including 23 path-shape candidates; none of those candidates is automatically a caller.

A performance improvement is not demonstrated. pg_stat function timing is unavailable under track_functions=none; pre-cutoff readiness stage durations exist, but 5.13 versus 5.13.1 differs in revision, time window, screen population, exact-zero prevalence and sample size. On overlapping screens 5.13.1 frequently has larger positive stage times, which is directional evidence only, not a causal regression proof.

The CP2 42501 is an authority/readback-path issue rather than demonstrated functional failure: the current read-only principal has no EXECUTE on either currentness-function variant but has SELECT on the evidence tables. Receipt 38 remains historical SOAK authority, not a current CP2 or performance receipt.

The P0 event itself carries acceptance_declared=false and provenance/currentness drift notes, so treating its LIVE_PG_PROC labels as timeless live authority would contradict the source's own provenance limits.

GDE narrows the high-value risk families to stale-currentness promotion, post-snapshot path evolution, identity qualification, wrong authority path and cohort equivalence. No role produced evidence sufficient to calibrate BARINEL or prove a single functional root cause.
